statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome
The service is to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings during daily activities
The diagnoses are R55 and I49.5
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
